items.title: Bolt Renderer
items.subtitle: TypeSript WebGL 2 Renderer
items.description:
Building an object-oriented WebGL 2 renderer using TypeScript, from scratch, with no external packages. I'm currently working on some refactors to the old content, since I've learned a lot more about good code standards and the rendering pipeline overall.

Current Support:
	- Canvas creation and rendering context setup
	- Custom vertex and fragment shader definition
	- Object-oriented color and vector support, with 
	   transformation functions

items.title: GPS-Enabled Livestock Eartag
items.subtitle: GE 1502 Final Project
items.description: A bluetooth-enabled livestock ear tag prototype with programmable ID data and passive GPS tracking technology. Designed for integrated tracking of herd behaviors and disease spread. I was responsible for speccing electronics, writing hardware-software interfaces for Bluetooth, GPS tracking, and ROM/Flash manipulation, and designing the form-fitting enclosure to secure everything.

items.title: CIFAR-10 Image Classifier
items.subtitle: EECE 2140 Final Project
items.description:
A PyTorch neural network model based on the VGG16 format. Within 100 generations, it achieved over 84% accuracy on the CIFAR-10 image classification dataset.

Included in the GitHub Repo:
	- A semi-formal writeup detailing the development 
	   process
	- Model weights for several iterations
	- Full, commented development code

items.title: FPGA-Controlled Spider Robot
items.subtitle: EECE 2160 Final Project
items.description: Designed FPGA circuits and C++ code to run a Terasic Spider Robot through a specified, natural walking moveset.
